command: sh -c "rm -rf /tmp/dolt_bak && (dolt ${CMD_DATA_ARGS} backup remove hivepaas_bak 2>/dev/null || true) && dolt ${CMD_DATA_ARGS} backup add hivepaas_bak file:///tmp/dolt_bak && dolt ${CMD_DATA_ARGS} backup sync hivepaas_bak > /dev/null && tar -czf - -C /tmp/dolt_bak . && rm -rf /tmp/dolt_bak"
desc: Sync Dolt database and commit history to a temp directory, compress and stream to stdout via tar
